title: Get 1TB of Koofr cloud storage for life for $159.99 through Aug. 5
content_html:
TL;DR: Get 1TB of Koofr Cloud Storage Lifetime for a one-time $159.99 through Aug. 5 with code KOOFR and store, sync, and access your files without recurring subscription payments.

Credit: Koofr

$159.99
$810 Save $650.01

Cloud storage has become one of those services that’s easy to forget about — until another monthly charge appears on your statement. If you’d rather pay once and move on, Koofr’s 1TB Lifetime Cloud Storage plan is worth a look.

Through Aug. 5, you can get 1TB of Koofr Cloud Storage for $159.99 with code KOOFR. Instead of paying a recurring subscription, you’ll have lifetime access to 1TB of storage for photos, videos, documents, backups, and everyday files.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Koofr works across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone, and the web, so your files stay within reach no matter which device you’re using. It also integrates with existing cloud services like Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Amazon, making it easier to manage everything from one place rather than juggling multiple accounts.

Privacy is another selling point. Files are encrypted during transfer and while stored, and Koofr doesn’t track your activity.

Helpful extras like duplicate file detection, advanced file management tools, and customizable sharing links make organizing large collections a little less tedious.

The platform has also earned 4.6 out of 5 stars on G2, which suggests users appreciate its balance of simplicity, flexibility, and reliable cloud storage.

If you’re planning to keep growing your digital library, a lifetime storage plan can make more sense than adding another recurring subscription to your monthly budget.
